company_name: JJmr-Clean-Air Solution Tech. Services Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical air quality and contamination control solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: JJmr-Clean-Air Solution Tech. Services Co., Ltd specializes in air quality and contamination control solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include AMC air washer equipment, chemical filters, and air diffusers, as well as energy-efficient washing equipment and exhaust gas pollution control systems, all designed to maintain optimal conditions in assembly and packaging environments.
